title: Query explicit upstream refs after shorthand transformation
failure_signature: The first read-only startup wrapper transformed Git upstream shorthand before Git parsed it, so divergence evidence was unavailable.
trigger_preconditions: revision shorthand was transformed before native parsing
candidate_workaround: Replace transformed revision shorthand with an explicit branch-ref lookup and retain the original parser failure.
recurrence_guard: In wrappers that may transform metasyntax, never assume Git revision shorthand reaches the native command unchanged.
rollback: Give the failed wrapper zero startup credit and make no branch change until the explicit query passes.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
